gitCommit.subject: Console: deferred verification per account for any business; no pilot mark, no test-only staff (D224, owner's amendment 2026-10-29)
gitCommit.body:
Console: deferred verification per account for any business; no pilot mark, no test-only staff (D224, owner's amendment 2026-10-29)

- Add a staff account for any business; each takes one of the business's seats,
  and a full store is refused by the server in words.
- The WhatsApp verification choice is offered for any business while the server's
  switch is on; the confirmation reads 'this number stays unverified'.
- The pilot mark and its strings are removed; so are the Test-only refusals.
- Tests: deferred-verification-console 11 (an ordinary business, and no pilot).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
